# Kunstnik — Maire Rästa

> Kunstnik Maire Rästa creates minimalist yet expressive artworks emphasizing the dialogue between light and form.

## Core Features / Products
- [Minust](https://www.mairerasta.eu/#minust): Discover Maire Rästa's artistic philosophy and approach to design.
- [Tööd](https://www.mairerasta.eu/#tood): Explore the collection of artworks crafted by Maire Rästa.

## Contact and Support
- [Kontakt](https://www.mairerasta.eu/#kontakt): Find contact information, including email and phone number for inquiries.
- [E-post](mailto:maire.rasta@gmail.com): Reach out directly via email for collaboration or exhibition information. 
- [Telefon](tel:+37254410017): Contact Maire Rästa by phone for immediate inquiries.
- [Sotsiaalmeedia](https://www.instagram.com/mairerasta): Follow Maire Rästa on Instagram for updates on new works and exhibitions.
- [Pood](https://maireart.eu): Visit the online store for purchasing artworks.
